subject: general
question: In April 2023, India’s External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar launched the project for restoration of which of the following ghats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tulsi Ghat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The project for the restoration of **Tulsi Ghat** was launched by India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar in April 2023.
 
• Tulsi Ghat is one of the renowned ghats in Varanasi, known for its historical and cultural significance.
 
• The restoration project aims to preserve the heritage and improve the facilities at Tulsi Ghat for pilgrims and tourists.
 
• Such initiatives are part of broader efforts to maintain and rejuvenate the cultural landmarks in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Varanasi**, also known as Kashi, is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world and holds immense religious significance in Hinduism.
 
• The ghats of Varanasi, including Tulsi Ghat, are steps leading down to the river Ganges and are used for various rituals and ceremonies.
 
• The restoration of these ghats is crucial for preserving the cultural heritage and ensuring the sustainability of the riverfront.
 
• Efforts to restore and maintain the ghats also contribute to the local economy by boosting tourism and providing employment opportunities.
